title: 世界を変えるダージリン

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Mejiro Dober wants to buy some tea, so she heads to the mall to sample different varieties.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: This Darjeeling is good… It has a nice, mellow aftertaste and is so fragrant as it goes down.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey, girl! I see you like my tea!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What? You're the one who brewed this?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes, I was chosen to give out samples for my talents. My method of making world-changing tea has been wildly popular!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I didn't know there was such a way to brew tea… Do you happen to, uh, offer lessons for that?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So you want to seize the world too? Very well! I'll teach you everything you need to know!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: First, you need to put tea leaves into a warmed teapot…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Okay! I put the leaves in!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: After you pour the hot water in, close the lid, and encourage the tea leaves in different languages while they steep!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Okay! Wait… Encourage the leaves in different languages? What?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: T-tea leaves… become mucho delicioso, s'il vous plaît…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Uh… Wo ai ni!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes, very good! I know it's a little embarrassing, but the tea leaves appreciate the gesture!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: D-does this really make it taste better?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Try it and see for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sip… Hm?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's delicious!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Isn't it? By showing appreciation to the leaves that have traveled all the way here from abroad—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I see! Doing so lets the leaves steep for just the right amount of time, thus perfectly drawing out their flavor! A basic but important step!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Really? I thought it was about Umamusume and tea coming together across the species barrier…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-I don't know about that…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But this helped remind me of the basics. I've been so busy lately that I forget to let the leaves steep!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The following day, Mejiro Dober's movements are sharper than usual during training!
